memories.content: Prefers oolong tea over coffee.
Works as a data engineer at a logistics company.
Lives in Lisbon with his family.
Has a cat named Mochi.
Has two daughters, aged 7 and 10.
Is allergic to peanuts.
Speaks Mandarin and English; prefers answers in English for technical topics.
Building OwnMemory, an encrypted memory server for Claude on Cloudflare Workers.
Chose AGPL as the license for OwnMemory.
Goes running three mornings a week before work.
Mostly vegetarian, but eats fish.
Uses a Pixel phone and an iPad.
Wants short, direct answers without long introductions.
Keeps a small vegetable garden on the balcony.
Drives an electric car, a Tesla Model 3.
最喜欢吃四川火锅，越辣越好。
周末喜欢去山里徒步。
父母住在成都，每年春节回去看他们。
正在学习做手工拉面。
Prefers window seats on long flights.
Saves 20 percent of income each month.
Writes code in VS Code with the Vim keybindings.
Listens to jazz while working.
Usually goes to bed around 11 pm.
